content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

A crypto payment gateway is a service that allows digital creators to accept cryptocurrency as payment for their products. Unlike traditional payment processors, which can charge hefty fees and impose strict regulations, crypto payment gateways like NOWPayments offer a more accessible and cost-effective solution. For instance, while Gumroad takes 10% from each sale, NOWPayments charges only 0.5%. This difference is crucial for creators, ensuring they retain more of their earnings, especially when scaling their sales volume.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a crypto payment gateway involves several key components working seamlessly together. At its core, it typically includes a front-end website to showcase products, a backend system to manage orders, and a payment processing service to handle the cryptocurrency transactions. For example, using Cloudflare Workers for logic and Google Drive for file delivery, creators can establish a robust and automated system that processes payments instantly and delivers digital products without any manual intervention, thereby enhancing the customer experience.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This system is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are either not available or unreliable. By focusing on individuals selling ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital goods, this infrastructure provides a solution tailored to their unique needs. It empowers them to bypass traditional barriers, allowing them to sell their creations directly to their audience while maintaining full ownership and control over their sales process.
Cut out the middleman and keep more of your earnings with crypto payments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Integrating the components of a crypto payment gateway involves selecting the right tools and services. For example, using GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend processes, and NOWPayments for payment verification creates a streamlined system. This combination ensures that creators have a reliable platform that requires no monthly fees or subscriptions while providing the necessary infrastructure to manage and scale their businesses effectively.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own crypto payment gateway, start by selecting a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your website. Next, set up your backend using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle payment logic. Integrate NOWPayments to facilitate cryptocurrency transactions. Finally, store your product files on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for efficient delivery. By following these steps, you can have a fully operational digital store ready to accept payments without relying on traditional payment processors.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments. This service allows you to accept cryptocurrency payments directly, which can significantly reduce fees compared to traditional platforms. Implementing this solution enables you to maintain control over your sales and retain more profit.
Reduce costs dramatically by avoiding traditional payment processing fees.

This kit provides all the essential blueprints and templates you need to build a sovereign digital commerce stack, allowing you to operate independently. You can find more details at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
